name: orb-extension
prompt: Write an extension that registers a programmable layer "Glow Orb" (fragment renderer): radius and softness sliders, a color, and a toggle to pulse with time.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote the "Glow Orb" layer definition (`gen.glow-orb`, fragment renderer), but I couldn't compile or render it because this run has no live tools. It has four controls: `radius` (0.02–1), `softness` (0–1), `color` (#ff7a2e) and a `pulse` toggle that makes the size and brightness swell once every 2 seconds. The docs don't list the time or size inputs for layer shaders; I assumed the shader-layer names `iTime`/`iResolution` (the docs' example uses this header's `uv`/`fragColor`), so a compile error naming them means swapping them out.
